cells.gaps: The 7-77 programme counts 1,166 people in online sessions, with in-person sessions only beginning at Sétif; no count shown in more than one location. No source found since October 2023 gives a measured share of people with basic digital skills.
cells.note: The national 7-77 programme opened in July 2026 and had reached 1,166 people online by August, with in-person sessions just begun at Sétif. A count shown in more than one location has not been found, so not stage 3.
